l-e-m2-b07-03.title: Comparatif ti aadjectifs so asuka na -y
l-e-m2-b07-03.goal: Wara règle na aexemples mingi ti comparatif na superlatif ti aadjectifs so asuka na -y, tene ni, na kaï ni na mbeni fini cas.
l-e-m2-b07-03.material: happy → happier → happiest. easy → easier → easiest. busy → busier → busiest. Wara règle na aexemples na sara kua na ni na funny.

l-e-m2-b07-03.s.s1.explain: Tongana mot asuka na consonne + y, change y na i na zia -er na -est.
